global_logup.note: the alpha/beta round of a block's global LogUp, which the group proofs share and none of them contains: scored under the group machines' parameters as a proof's own LogUp round is. The tree's root bounds the real rows of each direction below the field's order (the count, in units of count_unit_rows, is at most max_count), and a table is opened under a first WHIR round within the unique-decoding radius
